[APP-FORM@1:p1:2] Dwelling: grade II listed end-of-terrace cottage, 2 bedrooms
[APP-FORM@1:p1:3] Proposal: two-storey rear extension; internal alterations
[APP-FORM@1:p1:4] Parking: none on site
